[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Aleq Armond''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] at the [[Corulag Academy]]'s advanced engineering department, who worked with [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and researched a new [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] that could increase the flight speed of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]]. One of his students was in reality a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel sympathizer|sympathizer]] who plotted to sabotage the demonstration of the new ion engine system.
